question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{2,3,5,6,7,8,9,10\},$ and the set $S=\{2,3,5,6,7,8,9,10\}$ has $|S|=8$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{8}, & x=2,3,5,6,7,8,9,10 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ there are $3$ items $(8,9,10)$ that satisfy $7<X\le 10.$ Therefore,

$$
P(7<X\le 10)=3\cdot \frac{1}{8}=\frac{3}{8}.
$$
